description: Theme registry per CODEBOOK_TAXONOMY.md. 27 universal themes across 4 axes (hrqol/util/trial/life), plus per-indication overlay (dx.<indication>.*) reserved for the Safety Gate. surface_form_hints are SUGGESTION FUEL ONLY for the matcher — per-instance theme assignment lives in ThemeTag rows. Phase 1 seed; hints are populated incrementally as the sf36v2 lexicon merges and per-corpus extractors run.

items.label: Physical functioning
items.captures: Mobility, lifting, walking, self-care, basic physical activities

items.label: Role physical
items.captures: Physical health limiting work or daily role activities

items.label: Bodily pain
items.captures: Pain intensity, frequency, interference with normal work

items.label: General health
items.captures: Self-rated health, perceived current state, expected trajectory

items.label: Vitality
items.captures: Energy, fatigue, exhaustion, feeling worn out

items.label: Social functioning
items.captures: Health interfering with social activities and relationships

items.label: Role emotional
items.captures: Emotional state limiting work or daily role activities

items.label: Mental health
items.captures: Anxiety, depression, calm, mood, behavioral-emotional control

items.label: Access to care

provenance.citation: National Healthcare Quality and Disparities framework — Access dimension

items.captures: Getting to care — geographic distance, appointment availability, finding a specialist, in-network gating
items.excludes: Cost as access barrier — use util.coverage (plan design) or life.financial (household burden)

items.label: Coverage / plan design
items.captures: What the plan does/doesn't include — formulary, benefits design, covered vs. uncovered services
items.excludes: Carrier behavior on a specific claim — use util.insurance

items.label: Insurance / carrier friction
items.captures: Carrier behavior — denials, prior-auth battles, appeals, claim disputes
items.excludes: What the plan covers from the outset — use util.coverage

items.label: Patient-provider relationship
items.captures: Patient-provider trust, communication, being heard vs. dismissed
items.excludes: Patient information adequacy / self-research — use util.decision_support

items.label: Care coordination
items.captures: Handoffs between providers, records continuity, conflicting medical advice

items.label: Diagnostic journey
items.captures: Time to diagnosis, misdiagnosis loops, specialist hunt, second opinions

items.label: Decision support
items.captures: Patient information adequacy, weighing options, self-research, shared-decision capacity, decision regret
items.excludes: How the provider communicated — that's util.relationship

items.label: Trial awareness
items.captures: Knowing trials exist; how patients hear about them

items.label: Trial eligibility
items.captures: Criteria fit, exclusion frustration, age/biomarker gates

items.label: Trial enrollment
items.captures: Consent, decision-to-join, weighing pros/cons

items.label: Trial logistics
items.captures: Washout, visit cadence, diary compliance, protocol burden

items.label: Trial site relationship
items.captures: Coordinator, PI, site staff interactions; trust gaps

items.label: Trial retention
items.captures: During-trial sentiment; what makes patients stay or drop

items.label: Post-trial transition
items.captures: LTFU tail, access after the trial closes, transition to standard of care

items.label: Trial financial
items.captures: Stipends, hidden costs, post-trial drug access economics

items.label: Household financial
items.captures: Household-level economic fallout — out-of-pocket, lost wages, debt, medicine-vs-groceries
items.excludes: Carrier denials / prior auth — use util.insurance

items.label: Work / school / occupation
items.captures: Job accommodations, school absenteeism, forced early retirement, career disruption

items.label: Caregiver / family
items.captures: Spousal strain, family role reversals, caregiver burnout, child/partner impact

items.label: Identity / meaning
items.captures: Sense of self, future-self, hope, fear, faith, existential grief
